scripts.dev: node scripts/predev.mjs && node scripts/copy-opencv.mjs && npm run build -w @mynted/centering-core && npm run dev -w @mynted/web
scripts.build: node scripts/copy-opencv.mjs && npm run build -w @mynted/centering-core && npm run build -w @mynted/card-id && npm run build -w @mynted/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @mynted/centering-core && npm run typecheck -w @mynted/card-id && npm run typecheck -w @mynted/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @mynted/centering-core && npm run test -w @mynted/web
scripts.data:fetch: cd services/measure-py && uv run python -m generators.fetch_data
scripts.data:generate: cd services/measure-py && uv run python -m generators.synthetic
scripts.eval:synthetic: cd services/measure-py && uv run python -m eval.run --split test --set synthetic
scripts.eval:augmented: cd services/measure-py && uv run python -m eval.run --split test --set augmented
scripts.eval:real: cd services/measure-py && uv run python -m eval.run --split test --set real
scripts.parity: cd services/measure-py && uv run python -m eval.parity
scripts.py:dev: cd services/measure-py && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8001
